The '''Hythrope system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Hythrope sector/Legends|Hythrope sector]] of the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hythrope IV]].<ref name="CRO" />
